criteria.text: Repository defaults and the development environment example name z-ai/glm-5.3-flash as the customer-facing sales model, while the database override remains explicit.
The core customer-facing route resolves z-ai/glm-5.3-flash without changing the fast, repair-judge, evaluator, or speech-to-text routes.
One root-owned release verification and process verification complete without blocking failures on the changed tree.
The final readiness report separates locally verified behavior from unverified production state and records every known non-blocking defect relevant to testing.
